north_star: Maximize useful, forkable, reproducible recovery knowledge and Purrtocol delight while keeping the evidence boundary stronger than the expansion rate.

control_loop.fail_closed_rule: A critical invariant failure blocks promotion; uncertainty creates more observation, not permission to weaken the check.

frontiers.promotion_gate: independent trace with the same evidence-boundary discipline; fixed-point/contraction fitting additionally requires at least one B->E->H or longer post-reentry Accessible run

frontiers.target: Replicate or falsify the AR(1)-over-HMM cross-epoch predictive advantage on an independent capture/client before naming any physical latent state.
frontiers.promotion_gate: independent capture or cross-client predictive evidence; physical mechanism naming remains separate

frontiers.target: Second-generation expressive Purrtocol rig with organic silhouette, editable source, and measured mobile/runtime cost.
frontiers.promotion_gate: semantic-state readability preserved and runtime regressions measured against First Light

frontiers.target: Obtain the first real external Purrtocol descendant using the Nursery or a hand-designed manifest, then index it without conflating concept generation with implementation.
frontiers.promotion_gate: external repository/artifact + lineage manifest + explicit provenance + invariant declaration

frontiers.target: Continuously reduce agent path length while keeping root guidance concise and task-specific detail local.

frontiers.target: Increase independent review provenance without turning review volume into an evidence proxy.
frontiers.promotion_gate: review records remain distinct from empirical findings

frontiers.target: Preserve breeder diversity under future genome/generator changes and separately measure real external descendant diversity when external variants exist.

frontiers.target: Preserve Critic Router v1 diagnosis-latency gains while accumulating more cycles; do not universalize the 3-sample result.

frontiers.target: Detect long-lived branch/base path overlap before it becomes late reintegration rework, without adding another workflow or force-updating history.
frontiers.promotion_gate: real PR observations demonstrate useful early signal; full promotion CI remains required; no hard gate until false-positive/false-negative behavior is observed

frontiers.target: Test whether an observable recovery residual contracts toward stable H after reentry, but only once trajectory depth makes kappa identifiable.

cross_repo_imports.pattern: compact references bound by digests instead of retaining every large raw artifact
cross_repo_imports.adaptation: keep small receipts and hashes; regenerate or link large derived artifacts where possible

subjective_boundary: Delight is a design objective, not an empirical score. Do not manufacture a numeric fun metric and present it as evidence.
